The remaining second derivatives are:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2 \ell}{\partial (\sigma^2)^2}
&= \deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-1}
 + \frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2}
&& \text{(differentiate the score for $\sigma^2$)}\\
&= \deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-1}}
 + \deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= \deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-1}}
 + \deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2 \paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}}
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-1}
 + \frac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2 \deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\paren{-\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}}
 + \frac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2 \deriv{\sigma^2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}
&& \text{(power rule for $v^{-1}$)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\paren{-\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}}
 + \frac{1}{2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2 \paren{-2\paren{\sigma^2}^{-3}}
&& \text{(power rule for $v^{-2}$)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2} - \sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2 \paren{\sigma^2}^{-3}
&& \text{(multiply the constants)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2} - \paren{\sigma^2}^{-3}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
\frac{\partial^2 \ell}{\partial \mu \, \partial \sigma^2}
&= \deriv{\mu}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-1}
 + \frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2}
&& \text{(differentiate the score for $\sigma^2$)}\\
&= \deriv{\mu}\paren{-\frac{n}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-1}}
 + \deriv{\mu}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= 0 + \deriv{\mu}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2}
&& \text{(derivative of a constant)}\\
&= \deriv{\mu}\paren{\frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2}
&& \text{(drop the zero term)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\deriv{\mu}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)^2
&& \text{(constant multiple rule)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n \deriv{\mu}(x_i - \mu)^2
&& \text{(derivative of a sum is the sum of derivatives)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n -2(x_i - \mu)
&& \text{(chain-rule result from the score for $\mu$)}\\
&= \frac{1}{2}\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2} \cdot (-2) \sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)
&& \text{(factor the constant $-2$ out of the sum)}\\
&= -\paren{\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \mu)
&& \text{(multiply the constants)}
\end{aligned}
$$

At the MLE, $\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar x) = 0$
and $\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar x)^2 = n\hat\sigma^2$
(writing $\hat\sigma^2$ for $\hat\sigma^2_{\text{ML}}$), so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2 \ell}{\partial (\sigma^2)^2}\bigg|_{\text{MLE}}
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2} - \paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-3}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar x)^2
&& \text{(evaluate at $\mu = \bar x$, $\sigma^2 = \hat\sigma^2$)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2} - \paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-3} n\hat\sigma^2
&& \text{(substitute $\textstyle\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar x)^2 = n\hat\sigma^2$)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2} - n\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-3}\hat\sigma^2
&& \text{(reorder the factors)}\\
&= \frac{n}{2}\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2} - n\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $\hat\sigma^2$)}\\
&= -\frac{n}{2}\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}\\
\frac{\partial^2 \ell}{\partial \mu \, \partial \sigma^2}\bigg|_{\text{MLE}}
&= -\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2}\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar x)
&& \text{(evaluate at $\mu = \bar x$, $\sigma^2 = \hat\sigma^2$)}\\
&= -\paren{\hat\sigma^2}^{-2} \cdot 0
&& \text{(substitute $\textstyle\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar x) = 0$)}\\
&= 0
&& \text{(multiply by zero)}
\end{aligned}
$$
